recipes.description: Abalone and Chicken Congee is a comforting Chinese rice porridge flavored with tender chicken and delicate abalone, simmered into a creamy, nourishing dish.
instructions: Rinse the rice under cold water until the water runs clear, then soak it in water for about 30 minutes and drain.
Place the chicken pieces and ginger slices into a large pot with 2 liters of water. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 30 minutes to make a flavorful broth.
Remove the chicken from the broth and set aside to cool. Remove and discard the ginger slices from the broth.

Add the drained rice to the chicken broth and bring to a gentle boil. Reduce the heat and simmer, stirring occasionally to prevent sticking, for about 1 hour until the mixture becomes thick and creamy.
While the congee is cooking, shred the cooled chicken into bite-sized pieces.
Clean the abalone thoroughly, then slice into thin pieces.
Once the congee has thickened, add the shredded chicken and sliced abalone. Continue to simmer for another 10 minutes to heat through and meld flavors.
Season the congee with salt and white pepper to taste.
Ladle the congee into bowls and garnish with chopped spring onion and finely chopped coriander leaves before serving.
recipes.name: Abalone and Chicken Congee

recipes.description: Abalone and Chicken Soup is a nourishing Chinese soup combining tender chicken and delicate abalone, simmered with ginger and goji berries for a flavorful and healthful broth.
instructions: Rinse the abalone under cold water and scrub gently to clean, then slice thinly.
Cut the chicken into medium-sized pieces and blanch in boiling water for 5 minutes to remove impurities, then rinse and set aside.
In a large pot, bring 2 liters of water to a boil.
Add the chicken pieces to the boiling water and simmer for 30 minutes.
Add the sliced abalone, ginger slices, and goji berries to the pot and continue to simmer on low heat for another 30 minutes.
Season the soup with salt and white pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped green onion before serving.
recipes.name: Abalone and Chicken Soup

recipes.description: Adobo de Pollo is a traditional Filipino marinated fried chicken seasoned with garlic, vinegar, soy sauce, and spices, resulting in flavorful, tender, and crispy chicken.
instructions: In a bowl, combine garlic, vinegar, soy sauce, black pepper, bay leaf, and salt to create the adobo marinade.
Place chicken pieces in the marinade, ensuring they are fully submerged. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, preferably overnight for best flavor.
Remove chicken from the marinade and pat dry with paper towels to remove excess liquid.
Heat vegetable oil in a frying pan over medium heat.
Fry the marinated chicken pieces until golden brown and cooked through, about 8-10 minutes per side depending on size.
Once cooked, drain the chicken on paper towels to remove excess oil.
Serve hot with steamed rice and garnish with chopped parsley if desired.
recipes.name: Adobo De Pollo (Marinated Fried Chicken)

recipes.description: Alabama White Sauce Chicken is a Southern barbecue dish featuring grilled chicken coated with a tangy mayonnaise and vinegar-based white sauce, unique to Alabama's barbecue tradition.
instructions: Preheat the grill or oven to medium-high heat (about 190°C/375°F).
Season chicken pieces with salt and pepper.
In a bowl, combine mayonnaise, apple cider vinegar, lemon juice, horseradish, black pepper, salt, sugar, and cayenne pepper to make the Alabama white sauce.
Grill or bake the chicken until cooked through and the skin is crispy, about 30-40 minutes depending on piece size, turning occasionally.
Remove the chicken from heat and generously brush it with the Alabama white sauce while still hot.
Serve extra Alabama white sauce on the side for dipping.
recipes.name: Alabama White Sauce Chicken

recipes.description: Alambre de Pollo is a popular Mexican dish featuring sautéed chicken with bell peppers, onions, and tomatoes, topped with melted cheese and often served with tortillas and fresh garnishes.
instructions: Cut the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces and season with salt and pepper.
Chop the bell pepper, onion, and tomato into similar-sized pieces.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken pieces and cook until browned and cooked through, about 8-10 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the chopped bell pepper and onion, sauté until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the tomato and cook for another 2 minutes until slightly softened.
Return the chicken to the skillet and mix everything together.
Add shredded cheese on top and cover the skillet to allow the cheese to melt, about 2-3 minutes.
Sprinkle chopped fresh cilantro over the dish and serve with warmed flour tortillas, lime wedges, and optional sour cream or guacamole on the side.
recipes.name: Alambre De Pollo (Chicken Alambre)

recipes.description: Almond Chicken is a flavorful Chinese-American dish featuring tender stir-fried chicken with crunchy almonds and vegetables in a savory sauce. It is a popular dish known for its combination of textures and rich taste.
instructions: Soak the almond in warm water for about 30 minutes, then peel off the skin and set aside.
Cut the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces and season with salt and pepper.
Heat vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat, then stir-fry the chicken pieces until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, add a little more oil if needed and briefly stir-fry the peeled almonds until lightly golden. Remove and set aside.
Add chopped garlic and ginger to the pan and stir-fry until fragrant.
Add diced bell pepper and sliced celery, stir-frying until slightly tender but still crisp.
Return the chicken and almonds to the pan.
Mix soy sauce, chicken broth, sugar, and cornstarch in a bowl to make a sauce, then pour it into the pan.
Stir everything together and cook until the sauce thickens and coats the chicken and vegetables well.
Serve hot with steamed white rice.
recipes.name: Almond Chicken

recipes.description: American chicken fried rice is a quick and flavorful dish that combines cooked rice with chicken, scrambled eggs, and vegetables, seasoned with soy and oyster sauces for a classic take on a popular Asian-American favorite.
instructions: Cook the white rice according to package instructions and let it cool completely, preferably refrigerate for at least an hour.
Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the diced chicken and cook until it is no longer pink and slightly browned, then remove from the skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, add more oil if necessary and sauté the chopped onion and garlic until fragrant and translucent.
Add the mixed vegetables to the skillet and cook until tender.
Push the vegetables to one side of the skillet and scramble the beaten eggs on the other side until cooked through.
Combine the eggs with the vegetables and add the cooked rice and chicken back into the skillet, stirring well to mix all ingredients.
Pour soy sauce and a dash of oyster sauce over the rice mixture and stir fry for several minutes until everything is heated through and well combined.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, garnish with sliced green onions, and serve hot.
recipes.name: American Chicken Fried Rice

recipes.description: American chicken stir fry is a fast and flavorful dish featuring tender chicken strips and crisp vegetables cooked in a savory soy-based sauce, commonly served over rice or noodles.
instructions: Slice the chicken breast into thin strips.
Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken strips and stir-fry until cooked through and slightly browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, add a little more vegetable oil if needed, then add sliced bell pepper, sliced carrot, and chopped onion.
Stir-fry the vegetables until crisp-tender, about 4-5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and grated ginger, and cook for another 1 minute until fragrant.
Return the cooked chicken to the skillet with the vegetables.
In a small bowl, mix soy sauce, oyster sauce, brown sugar, and cornstarch dissolved in water.
Pour the sauce mixture into the skillet and stir well to coat all ingredients.
Cook and stir for 2-3 minutes until the sauce thickens.
Garnish with sliced green onion and serve hot over steamed rice or noodles.
recipes.name: American Chicken Stir Fry

recipes.description: Arabaşı Soup is a traditional chicken and dough soup from Kastamonu, Turkey, featuring hand-rolled wheat dough cooked in rich chicken broth, known for its comforting and hearty taste.
instructions: Mix the wheat flour and warm water in a large bowl to form a smooth, thick dough. Cover and let it rest while preparing the broth.
In a large pot, add the chicken pieces and cover with water. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer and cook until the chicken is tender, about 45 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the broth and set aside to cool. Strain the broth to remove impurities and return the clear broth to the pot.
Shred the cooled chicken into small pieces and return some of it to the broth for flavor.
Shape the rested dough into thin, flat sheets or ribbons by rolling it out and cutting it thinly.
Bring the broth to a gentle boil and add the dough strips carefully to avoid sticking.
Cook the dough in the broth until it becomes tender and floats to the surface, about 8-10 minutes.
Season the soup with salt, crushed red pepper, and if desired, add a drizzle of melted butter or chili oil for extra flavor.
Serve hot, garnished with the shredded chicken and optionally fresh parsley for a fresh touch.
recipes.name: Arabaşı Soup (Chicken Dough Soup from Kastamonu)

recipes.description: Arroz con Pollo is a traditional Latin American dish featuring chicken cooked with rice, vegetables, and spices for a flavorful and comforting meal.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add chopped onion, garlic, and green bell pepper; sauté until softened.
Add chicken pieces and cook until browned on all sides.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for a minute.
Add rice and stir well to coat with the oil and vegetables.
Pour in chicken broth and add saffron or turmeric for color.
Season with salt, pepper, cumin, and oregano.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and cover the skillet.
Simmer for about 20 minutes until rice is cooked and chicken is tender.
Add frozen peas during the last 5 minutes of cooking.
Once done, let it rest covered for 5 minutes before serving.
Fluff the rice with a fork, garnish with chopped parsley, and serve.
recipes.name: Arroz Con Pollo (Rice with Chicken)
